thread:
owen: hey all, day 2 here. need staging console ff-admin and a short-lived sa key to run smoke tests. who should i ask? :wave:

people-ops-bot: Please use the onboarding form: https://redwood.internal/onboard-access. Include project, flag id, and desired TTL. Auto-grouping applies after Day 1.

owen: tried the form, got "provisioning group not found". i think i wasn't added to console-admins.

rebecca: welcome owen! i'll check provisioning. sometimes AD sync lags. what's your okta email?

owen: owen@redwood.example

rebecca: adding you to `console-admins` now, will take a few mins to propagate.

infra: note: for ff-admin we require a justification string in the form. keep it short: "smoke tests for ENG-9001".

devops-oncall: if you need a SA key fast i can issue one with 12h TTL: roles `inference.invoker` + `logging.writer`. say the word.

owen: yes please for 12h. also flag id is `payments.model_canary` under project `payments-staging`.

rebecca: group added, try the form again.

owen: form accepted and JIT requested with note. submitted SA key request too.

devops-oncall: created SA `sa-owen-smoke`, TTL=12h. vault path: secret/data/onboard/owen/sa-key.

infra: JIT approved by rebecca. toggle window opens 30m from now. remember to document the run in the PR.

owen: got the key and access, can flip the flag. thanks everyone!

people-ops-bot: Audit note: group `console-admins` membership added for owen by rebecca.

owen: one quick follow-up  who owns flag metadata so i can add the experiment link?

rebecca: ping `@platform-flag-owners` and open a tiny PR to infra/feature-flags with owner alias and link. i can review.

owen: will do. thanks again :thumbsup:
